headline: Judge tosses publishers' antitrust suits over Google AI Overviews
body: A quiet day. Judge Amit Mehta dismissed antitrust suits from Chegg and Penske Media over Google's AI Overviews, ruling that 'an expectation is not an agreement'. Leaving a dominant player unchallenged is a small rise in Power Concentration, lifting Enslaved God. Apple tightened macOS Full Disk Access over AI-agent privacy risks, a small check on surveillance. Horizon Balance slipped to -12.85.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.1 and Libertarian Utopia -0.1 came from the Google ruling (+0.11 and -0.11), with Egalitarian Utopia -0.1 (-0.07).
